fluff.overview: The AFFS treats its infantry as professionals rather than expendable garrison filler, drawing soldiers from single worlds or neighboring systems to build the unit cohesion that the Federated Suns considers essential to effective combined-arms operations. Motorized platoons ride light vehicles that give them the speed to screen advancing columns, patrol supply routes, and respond to threats faster than foot infantry, though they sacrifice protection for that mobility. Carrying medium recoilless rifles that fire shaped-charge warheads, these platoons field crew-served weapons heavy enough to threaten armored vehicles at ranges beyond what personal arms can achieve.
